title: Gold Jumps With Silver as Markets Track Push to Reopen Hormuz
summary: Gold hit a four-week high as the prospect of an interim deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eased concerns about the outlook for inflation and reduced the odds of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates.

title: Next Lifts Outlook as UK’s Hot Summer Boosts Clothing Sales
summary: Next Plc raised its outlook for the third time this fiscal year, after sales surged in the second quarter due to warm UK weather and pent-up demand in the Middle East and northern Europe.

title: Australia Stocks Rise to Record on Iran Hopes, Economic Bets
summary: Australia’s stock benchmark climbed to a record on easing concerns over the US-Iran conflict and supportive signals in the domestic economy.

title: Novo Underwhelms Investors With Soft Wegovy Pill Sales
summary: Novo Nordisk A/S’s popular Wegovy weight-loss pill disappointed investors with sales that failed to live up to the hype of an obesity drug whose launch was billed the most successful in history.

title: Schaeffler Targets 1,300 Job Cuts With Early Pension Push
summary: Schaeffler AG plans to cut its German workforce through an expanded phased-retirement program as weak automotive demand continues to pressure the supplier.

title: Glencore Has Taken a Provision on Radiant World Exposure
summary: Glencore Plc said it has taken a provision on its exposure to iron ore trader Radiant World but that the exposure was not material to the company.

title: Allianz to Buy UOB Asset Management Unit as CEO Targets Asia
summary: Allianz SE agreed to buy the asset management unit of Singapore’s United Overseas Bank Ltd., marking the German insurer’s second major deal in recent days as Chief Executive Officer Oliver Baete pursues growth in the region.

title: Glencore Profit Jumps on Trading Boom and Record Copper
summary: Glencore Plc reported a steep jump in profits after a surge in the price of its most important commodities and its trading unit had one of its best ever periods as the Iran war sent energy prices soaring.

title: Honda Raises Outlook 30% as Weak Yen, US Demand Lift Profits
summary: Honda Motor Co. raised its profit outlook after quarterly results were boosted by a weak yen and strong demand in the US for gas-electric hybrids.

title: Vietnam’s Techcombank Seeks $1 Billion, Joining Rush for Funds
summary: Vietnam Technological and Commercial JSB, known as Techcombank, is seeking a $1 billion loan for regular business operations, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be one of the Southeast Asian nation’s largest debt deals this year.

title: China Sells Long-Dated Offshore Yuan Bonds at Record Low Yields
summary: China sold long-dated yuan-denominated sovereign bonds in Hong Kong at record-low yields, underscoring strong demand from global investors for the offshore issuance.

title: Stocks Rally to Record, Oil and Dollar Dip on Iran: Markets Wrap
summary: Global stocks climbed to a record as investors renewed bets on the artificial intelligence trade, driving gains in chipmakers. Oil and the dollar fell on the prospect of an interim US-Iran deal.

title: FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Rise as Glencore, Next Rally on Earnings
India's Inflation Cushion 'Thinner' Than It Seems
summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept its benchmark rate unchanged for a fourth straight review as it waits to see whether higher energy costs from the Iran war spill over into broader inflation. Prior to the decision, Standard Chartered Bank Head of India Economic Research Anubhuti Sahay told us the country's inflation has been benign so far, but the cushion is thinner than it appears. She speaks with Paul Allen on Bloomberg's "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Key Options Trade Displays Abnormal Pattern With India Auction
summary: A key options trade particularly popular in India to bet on volatility on the day equity derivatives expire showed an unusual pattern on Tuesday, highlighting a potential trading opportunity as market players grapple with a new mechanism for determining closing prices.

title: Pakistan’s Fintech Abhi Eyes Microfinance Bank IPO
summary:
Abhi Co-Founder & CEO Omair Ansari says the Pakistani fintech group expects to launch an initial public offering of its microlender in early September this year. He speaks with Paul Allen on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SoftBank-Backed OfBusiness Is Said to Explore Reviving India IPO
summary: OFB Tech Pvt, the operator of technology supply chain and financing platform OfBusiness, is considering reviving plans for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $800 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: US Copper Trades Near Record on Tariff Risks, Hormuz Speculation
summary: Copper futures in New York traded just short of an all-time high, as investors awaited a decision on US tariffs, while also tracking a push to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that lifted demand for risk assets.
